teks: If there was a straight road to the Moon and you walked nonstop, how long would it take?
Guess first! A, 9 months. B, 9 years. Or C, 90 years.
The average distance from Earth to the Moon is 384,400 kilometers.
Assume you walk at 5 kilometers per hour and never sleep.
So 384,400 divided by 5 gives 76,880 hours, or 3,203 days.
Even a car at 100 kilometers per hour needs 160 days. The answer is B, almost 9 years of walking!
